Both files rewritten.

**`parser.mjs`**
- `parseOrders(text)` still exported; throws `TypeError` for non-string input.
- Splits on `\n`, strips a trailing `\r` (CRLF support), skips blank/whitespace-only rows.
- Requires exactly 3 comma-separated fields; trims each field.
- SKU validated against `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9-]*$`; quantity/price must be pure base-10 digits (`/^[0-9]+$/`, so no signs, decimals, exponents, or empty strings), quantity must be > 0, price may be 0.
- Values exceeding `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` throw `RangeError`; other malformed rows throw `Error`.
- Returns a fresh array of `{ sku, quantity, unitPriceCents }` in input order, duplicates preserved.

**`report.mjs`**
- `buildReport(text)` still exported; delegates to `parseOrders`.
- Aggregates per SKU via a local `Map` (no cross-call state), computing `totalCents` as `quantity * unitPriceCents` per row.
- Checks `RangeError` on per-row product, running `totalUnits`, running `totalCents`, and per-SKU aggregate quantity/cents.
- `items` is a new array sorted lexicographically by SKU; empty input yields `{ items: [], totalUnits: 0, totalCents: 0 }`.

No tests were run — only the two files were read and rewritten; no execution environment was available.
